sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which spreadsheet function is used to find the highest numerical value within a selected range of cells?
Which of the following represents a mixed cell reference in an electronic spreadsheet?
In a digital presentation software, which view is most suitable for easily rearranging the sequence of multiple slides?
What is the primary function of animation triggers in a digital presentation?
options: A) To change the background color of all slides
B) To apply motion effects to individual objects on a single slide
C) To transition smoothly between two separate slides
questions.answer: B) To apply motion effects to individual objects on a single slide

questions.question_text: True or False: Filtering data in a spreadsheet permanently deletes the rows that do not match the chosen criteria.
Which prefix indicates that a website connection is encrypted and secure for transferring sensitive data?
Which mathematical operator symbol must always be typed first to initiate a formula in a spreadsheet cell?
What type of malicious software is specifically designed to lock a user out of their system until a sum of money is paid?
True or False: Using the same strong password across multiple online accounts is a recommended cyber safety practice.
Which feature ensures that a company logo appears in the exact same position on every single slide of a presentation?
Explain the practical difference between sorting and filtering data in a spreadsheet. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Sorting organizes data in ascending or descending alphabetical or numerical order. Filtering temporarily hides rows that do not meet specific criteria, displaying only relevant information.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of utilizing a Master Slide when designing a large digital presentation? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A Master Slide stores information about the theme, layouts, colors, and fonts. It ensures consistent formatting across all slides in a presentation without manual adjustments.

questions.question_text: Define ransomware and outline its primary negative impact on a targeted computer system. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Ransomware is malicious software that encrypts a victim's files or locks them out of their device, demanding a financial payment to restore access to the system.

questions.question_text: Describe how a Mixed Cell Reference functions when a formula is copied to another cell. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A mixed reference locks either the column or the row using a dollar sign. When copied, the locked part remains constant while the unlocked part adjusts automatically.

questions.question_text: Differentiate between Slide Transitions and Custom Animations in the context of digital presentations. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Slide transitions are visual effects applied when moving from one slide to the next. Custom animations are applied to individual objects like text or images within a single slide.

questions.question_text: A teacher needs to calculate total marks in cells C2 to F2, then copy this for 40 students. Write the exact formula and explain the dragging process. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Type =SUM(C2:F2) in cell G2 to calculate the total. To copy this for 40 students, click cell G2, grab the fill handle at the bottom-right corner, and drag it down to cell G41 to apply relative referencing.

questions.question_text: An unfamiliar pop-up warns that your computer is infected and prompts you to download a free antivirus tool immediately. Analyze this security risk and explain the correct response. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: This is a scareware tactic designed to trick users into downloading actual malware. Do not click the pop-up or download the software. Instead, close the browser window immediately and run a scan using your trusted, pre-installed antivirus program.

questions.question_text: Explain the specific procedure required to link a constantly updating spreadsheet chart into a presentation slide, ensuring the presentation automatically reflects new data entered into the source spreadsheet. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Open the spreadsheet, select the target chart, and copy it. Switch to the presentation slide, go to the 'Paste Special' menu, and choose 'Paste Link'. This creates a dynamic connection. Whenever source data changes in the spreadsheet, the linked chart in the presentation will automatically update to reflect the newest metrics.

questions.question_text: Case Study: A student notices their email sending spam to contacts without permission and cannot log in. Deduce the specific security breach that occurred and outline four immediate recovery steps the student must take. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The account has suffered a security breach and is compromised. The student must immediately utilize the account recovery page to reset their password, enable two-factor authentication, notify their contact list to ignore recent malicious emails, and perform a comprehensive antivirus scan on their computer to remove any hidden password-stealing malware.
